c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages; w['late']=w.year>=1876
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
cells=[(k,x.r.values) for k,x in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
bs=[]
for i in range(4000):
  m={k:rng.choice(v,len(v)).mean() for k,v in cells}
  bs.append(np.mean([m[(g,True)]-m[(g,False)] for g in w.genre.unique()]))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
au=w.author_key.unique();idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(au)};w['ai']=w.author_key.map(idx)
bs2=[]
for i in range(500):
  wt=np.bincount(rng.integers(0,len(au),len(au)),minlength=len(au))[w.ai.values]
  d=w.assign(wt=wt); d=d[d.wt>0]
  g=d.assign(rw=d.r*d.wt).groupby(['genre','late'])[['rw','wt']].sum(); g=(g.rw/g.wt).unstack()
  bs2.append((g[True]-g[False]).mean())
print('author',np.percentile(bs2,[2.5,97.5]))
for nm,d in [('high',w[w.date_confidence=='high']),('UK',w[w.origin=='UK']),('US',w[w.origin=='US']),('unk',w[w.origin=='unknown']),('1850-1900',w[w.year.between(1850,1900)]),('ed1',w[w.n_editions<=1]),('noyr1800',w[w.year>1800])]:
